entry.title: Cœur Défense
entry.note: The native frame retains the platform relation and both exact tower-part QIDs Q117352210/Q117352218. All three esplanade fingers and the northwest tower offset are explicit; the tower centers are not replaced by the whole-platform center. The relation is tagged height=1 m and describes the low ground platform, not the union of all upper tower projections. The tall blades extend outside it on the northwest side, as the independent tower-part polygons show. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
